Download the latest version from the thread here: Ancile v1.8

Changes (See "docs\changes.txt" for full list):

  • Added Automatic updates for plugin data
  • Blocking Monthly preview updates by default
  • You can now run Ancile on Windows 10

Windows Monthly Preview Updates

I've decided to start blocking the optional monthly preview updates by default. It's my feeling that Ancile users don't want to be beta testers for Microsoft updates that may not be ready for release.

Windows 10

I've moved the OS check from the main Ancile script over to the responsibility of each individual plugin. This means that Ancile will now (again) run under Windows 10, and people can create plugins specifically for each version of Windows. It's important to note that I do not test under Windows 10. The plugins that do run should be safe, but I can't guarantee that.

Automatic updates

Ancile now checks the data folders for an update file, and will download updates for each plugin. This does NOT update the scripts themselves just the data that the scripts reference. This will make keeping script data up to date much easier. There will still be updates to Ancile and it's plugins, but I'll no longer have to put out an update to Ancile every time Microsoft releases an unwanted update.
